title: Monique Marvez: Not Skinny, Not Blonde | FULL COMEDY SPECIAL
description:
Monique Marvez—one of the Original Latin Divas of Comedy and one of Snoop Dogg’s Bad Girls of Comedy—takes the stage in her hilarious one hour comedy special, "Not Skinny, Not Blonde."

With three marriages behind her and plenty of lessons learned, Monique delivers brutally honest—and incredibly funny—observations about love, relationships, men, women, and the mistakes we all make along the way. It is all wrapped in engaging storytelling, razor-sharp humor, and just the right amount of bacon.

Monique Marvez is more than a stand-up comedian. She is a cultural translator, relationship whisperer, and fearless truth-teller who connects generations while delivering an “aha” for every “ha-ha.”

Moniques's credits include The Original Latin Divas of Comedy, Snoop Dogg Presents: The Bad Girls of Comedy, Live in Hermosa, and two hit Dry Bar Comedy specials—including a 2024 release that reached No. 1 and generated more than 70 million views. Her second Dry Bar special is now climbing fast and streaming on Dry Bar Comedy, so after watching this special, head over there to see her latest special and follow her on all social media, links below.
